text:
Nora L.: Heads-up: nightly int8 bringup for atlas-lite shows a reproducible regression on the cjk-vertical-emoji set (-4.7 BLEU).

eval-bot: Regression alert: atlas-lite (int8) | cjk_vertical_emoji_smoke | BLEU -4.7 | 2026-04-02T07:14Z. Link: https://console.redwood/ops/regressions/INF-12011

Hao W.: Minimal repro? tokenizer id dump?

Nora L.: Repro command:
```bash
python -m evals.run --model atlas-lite --quant int8 --suite cjk_vertical_emoji_smoke --batch 8
```
Sample raw: "\u9999\u6e2f\ud83c\udded\ud83c\uddf0
\u4e2d\u6587\u00b7\u6ce8\u97f3"
Gold detok: "\u9999\u6e2f \ud83c\udded\ud83c\uddf0
\u4e2d\u6587\u00b7\u6ce8\u97f3"
int8 detok: "\u9999\u6e2f\u200b\ud83c\udded\ud83c\uddf0
\u4e2d\u6587\u00b7\u6ce8\u200b\u97f3"  <-- unexpected U+200B

Samir D.: Token ids? If the extra id is present pre-decoding it's a tokenizer wheel issue in the int8 image.

Nora L.: IDs: gold/fp32 -> [1201, 4096, 12, 5321]
fp32 run -> [1201, 4096, 12, 5321]
int8 image -> [1201, 4096, 12, 77, 5321]  # 77 maps to control/ZWSP

Hao W.: Infra note: the int8 image build bumped tokenizer wheel on 2026-04-01. Starting bisect of image layers. Freeze int8 rollout for canary.

Samir D.: Short-term: added post-detok sanitizer in eval harness to strip U+200B and added a focused smoke test. PR: https://phabricator.redwood/r/PR-6219

Nora L.: Agree upstream fix in tokenizer normalization is preferred. I'll run a wheel bisect and post the bad wheel hash. INF-12011 created with logs + payloads.

Hao W.: Thanks. Also adding a regression monitor that alerts if any locale test gets >3 BLEU drop after quant rollouts.

Samir D.: Good call. Will follow up with tokenizer-team. :thumbsup:
